rules.name: Страховая сумма ОСАГО
rules.applicability: Explicit total compulsory motor third-party liability insurance sum for the user-confirmed contract applicability date. This is not a requirement to reproduce the provision in an offer.
rules.interpretation: Compare an explicit total insurance sum in UZS, excluding premiums, property/life sublimits, examples and conditional cases. An absent total is NOT_FOUND; incorporation and uncertain dates require review. Transition treatment of existing contracts is not adjudicated.

мажбурий суғурта суғурта суммаси суғурта пули сўм

versions.version_note: Historical official wording inspected; current clause's previous-version link leads to this 2019 text. Resolution 222 amendment effective 2019-06-17. App deliberately restricts applicability to 2024-08-05 and later.
Resolution 458 of 2025-07-23 amendment; clause-specific effective date 2026-01-01, not its publication date. Verified through access date only.

rules.name: Срок выплаты после решения страховщика
rules.applicability: Explicit deadline for paying insurance indemnity after adoption of an insurer's payment decision. Substantive obligation, not a verified verbatim-offer disclosure obligation.
rules.interpretation: Screen explicit payment deadlines measured from the insurer's decision. Five working days is the statutory deadline. A shorter unambiguous working-day deadline is treated as consistent for this limited screen. Calendar-day deadlines, absent triggers and negated obligations require interpretation.
uncertainty_conditions: deadline triggered by a different event
queries: страховое возмещение выплата пять рабочих дней со дня принятия решения страховщика

versions.version_note: Paragraph 66 identical in inspected 2019 and current official text. effective_from is a conservative supported-version boundary, not a claim this obligation originated in 2024.

rules.name: Срок уведомления о решении
rules.applicability: Explicit deadline for notifying the policyholder of a payment/refusal decision after a written or electronic request for indemnity. Does not audit refusal reasons or establish a mandatory-offer disclosure requirement.
rules.interpretation: Screen notification deadlines after a written/electronic request. The source says fifteen days, without the working-day modifier used in paragraph 66. Explicit working-day wording requires review; ordinary or calendar-day wording is compared as an engineering interpretation awaiting legal review.
